title: Met-A on sequencing: what the healthy spread is made of
set_out: Find why sorted-cell Met-A on sequencing still falls with depth on healthy samples, then the islands and IAM-A, so every reading of the chain reads healthy sequenced samples Normal before the sequencing atlas is finished.
open_at_turnover: The IAM Sequencing Atlas's checklist: masks, genome-distance spectra and null tests next.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Pass 4's depth trend, diagnosed
entries.what: From committed chain outputs, each healthy input's disorder per read at its identity sites, against the donors it was read against.
entries.outcome: Met-A follows that ratio almost exactly; shallower libraries of a cell hold more off-pattern reads at its identity sites. Not purity, not general library error.

entries.title: The islands on sequencing: synthetic
entries.what: Six constructed healthy B-cell samples read by the one command with the expectation from the reference's own reads.
entries.outcome: Met: median 0.9963 against a bar of 1 within 0.02; the plug-in expectation read 1.0358 on the same samples.

entries.title: Healthy pass 5: every reading on sequencing
entries.what: All 137 healthy sequencing inputs read by the full chain against the IAM Sequencing Atlas, the islands from the reference's own reads.
entries.outcome: Met: islands 1.0122 (bar within 0.05 of 1); Met-A in each cell 1.0077, whole sample 1.0055, domains 1.0011, C-Score 1.0004, coupling-A 1.0000, IAM-A 0.9518.

entries.title: The X chromosome and Met-A
entries.what: Met-A with and without the X chromosome's identity sites on the 137 healthy inputs.
entries.outcome: No effect: 1.0077 both ways; largest change 0.0021.

entries.title: The sequencing atlas's null test on the sphere
entries.what: Each cell's two noise maps against 20 shuffles of their own values, after a synthetic.
entries.outcome: Met: the counting-only map stays inside its null in all 56 cells; the donor-half map lies above it in every cell, the person-to-person part.

entries.title: The genome-distance spectrum
entries.what: The noise maps' correlation by the distance between sites, after a synthetic read by the one command.
entries.outcome: Met: the counting map reads no correlation at any distance; healthy people differ mostly among neighboring CpGs, fading by about 1 Mb.

entries.title: The bridge to IAM-Atlas v2.1
entries.what: Each of the 56 shared cells, sequencing against array, at every shared site.
entries.outcome: Median correlation 0.9941; the sequencing level sits below v2.1's in every cell, the platform difference measured.

entries.title: The transfer function at the islands
entries.what: A planted change at the islands of a healthy B-cell sample, five sizes, read back by the one command.
entries.outcome: Met: the chain returns the change at full size (slope 1.0001).

entries.title: Isotropy by chromosome
entries.what: Each autosome's mean of the noise maps per cell.
entries.outcome: The counting map is the same on every autosome in every cell.

entries.title: The islands' expectation from the reference's own reads
entries.what: Each read of a healthy sample drawn without replacement from its mix's reference reads, so no counted level is treated as exact.
entries.outcome: In the chain behind a development flag; per-half island counts built for 56 cells at 66986 island sites.

entries.title: Per-site tables for the territories
entries.what: Each island and domain site's reads, levels and disorder, written beside the bundle on request.
entries.outcome: Used to find the islands' cause on a spent healthy sample.

entries.title: The sequencing atlas on the sky sphere
entries.what: Each cell's level and the 95 % range of its average, drawn for 56 cells by v2.1's builder.
entries.outcome: Range synthetic met (two donors 1.005 and 0.948, three donors 1.007 and 0.948).

entries.title: The sequencing atlas's information globe
entries.what: The information globe built from the sequencing atlas beside v2.1's.
entries.outcome: 534617 sites placed; families gather about as tightly as on v2.1's (0.42 against 0.35).

entries.title: The sequencing atlas's two noise maps
entries.what: Donor-half and read-half noise maps on the sky sphere for every cell.
entries.outcome: Check met (1238368 of 1238368); the X chromosome in 16 cells and a smooth-muscle donor offset seen and annotated.

entries.title: The globe and information sphere on sequencing
entries.what: A sequenced sample's globe and its distance from its own healthy self now drawn against the sequencing atlas; atlas inputs flagged.
entries.outcome: Being tested on 35 healthy samples outside the atlas, read both ways.
